title: Observable Plot: stack-midpoint text label — two contrasting configurations
purpose: Operationalizes one claim from art_01M6MH8DFE1KD1GQA0A0VTGENT (r3): that the stack midpoint output places text correctly on stacked bars. Provides two minimal configurations — one using the documented stackY2 midpoint channel, one without it — so a practitioner can run them side by side and observe whether the label lands at the bar midpoint or at the baseline. Variables held fixed: same data, same font, same colour; only the text channel changes. This is the discriminating test the checklist flagged as untested.
